caption: Count usable aligned reads at the position of interest; do not substitute the assay’s breadth or average depth. The toy 4×, 2× and 0× values are invented teaching values, not clinical thresholds. Broader territory guarantees neither uniform local sensitivity, all-variant detection nor clinical utility.
alt: A toy assay marks a selected DNA territory and a region outside its design. A local zoom aligns four invented reads across position P and two across position Q, giving depths of 4× and 2× at those specific positions. A second targeted region R has no usable aligned reads despite being included in the design. The schematic complements the preserved panel/exome/genome territory illustration; it is not a category ranking, coverage threshold, variant-detection probability or clinical-utility claim.
